name: week
title: Weekly succession review
subtitle: Evidence checks and development commitments. Review only, no appointments.

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from attention order by due nulls last, reference

sections.title: Coverage by role
sections.sql: select code,role,owner,coverage,usable_successors,ready_names from role_coverage order by code

sections.title: Development
sections.sql: select code,role,person,task,owner,due,status,blocking from development_board order by due

name: bench
title: Successor coverage
subtitle: Shared successors need a capacity decision by the role owners.

sections.title: Recorded readiness
sections.sql: select role,person,readiness,interest,availability,stale,blocking_actions,usable from successor_status order by role_code,person_code

sections.title: One person, several roles
sections.sql: select * from shared_successors order by person_code

name: privacy
title: People record review
subtitle: Evidence prompts against selected NZ privacy principles, not a legal certification.

sections.title: Records needing review
sections.sql: select * from compliance_findings order by rule,reference
